title: Sam Has a Cold
text:
Sam is sick today. He has a cold. He has a sore throat and a headache. He stays in bed.

His mother gives him hot tea and soup. She says he must drink a lot of water. Sam feels better in the evening. He wants to play outside tomorrow.

questions.text: What does Sam's mother give him?
Why does Sam stay in bed?
options: He is sick and needs rest
He wants to sleep at school
He is waiting for a train

questions.text: What is Sam probably going to do tomorrow?
options: Go to school with a cold

vocabulary.definition: an illness that makes your nose run and your throat feel sore
a warm liquid food, often made with vegetables or meat
the clear liquid that people drink to stay healthy

paragraph_translations: Сем сьогодні хворий. У нього застуда. У нього болить горло і голова. Він лишається в ліжку.
Мама дає йому гарячий чай і суп. Вона каже, що він має пити багато води. Увечері Сему стає краще. Завтра він хоче погратися на вулиці.
